### Description
**We are Proud to be SJE!**
At **SJE** , we are more than a company — we are a family of brands with a shared vision and mission to provide industry-leading, innovative, and reliable control and monitoring solutions that improve efficiencies, protect the environment, and deliver dependable solutions to our valued customers.  We are looking for a **Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence** to support our SJE Revere brand.

...

The **Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence** provides leadership for SJE’s manufacturing network and drives the operating improvements required to support growth, quality, delivery, and profitability. This leader will build a more standardized, scalable manufacturing model across SJE ECS sites, with particular focus on panel manufacturing, PanelConnex manufacturing, automation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.

...

**The skills you need:**
What will you do in this role:
**Manufacturing Strategy and Network Development**
* Lead the development and implementation of the future-state manufacturing network, including hub-and-spoke roles, site capabilities, work-share processes, and capacity planning.
* Define which products, projects, and manufacturing activities should remain local versus move to manufacturing hubs or shared-service capabilities.
* Establish clear operating requirements for manufacturing hubs, spoke sites, and customer FAT locations.

...

* Monitor and improve core operational performance measures, including safety, first-pass yield, rework, on-time delivery, schedule adherence, manufacturing hours versus estimate, scrap, uptime, and test pass rate.
* Support site leaders in creating focused recovery plans when performance falls below target.
* Help evaluate manufacturing footprint decisions, including facility expansions, consolidations, make-versus-buy opportunities, and outsourced fabrication.
